dedupe_keys.name: syke open spatial datasets web map services and environmental data apis finnish environment institute

description: The Finnish Environment Institute (Syke) publishes its open geospatial datasets as download packages, with metadata and latest update dates, in the ETRS-TM35FIN coordinate system. The list read has about 90 national datasets, among them flood hazard areas for lake and river floods and for sea floods, flood risk zones, historic flood maps, heights of bridges, buildings and building addresses of the Built Environment Information System (updated weekly), built-up land, CORINE land cover and a 2 m land cover for 2022, groundwater areas, catchment areas, lake and river depth, hydrological observations, environmental noise maps, traffic restriction areas, nature protected areas and Natura 2000, wetland and mire layers, peatland drainage status and the YKR urban structure datasets. Syke also runs web map services and OData REST interfaces for water quality, phytoplankton and hydrology, the latter with observed or calculated values for about 5,000 stations or areas (precipitation, evaporation, runoff, discharge, water level, snow water equivalent, ice thickness and water temperature), version 1.2 of 11 May 2026. Open data is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, citing Syke and the dataset name, and access is free; some other data have specific restrictions. Caveats: some metadata is in Finnish only, and update dates vary by dataset. Coverage is Finland. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis, such as overlaying flood hazard areas on buildings, roads and bridges, and hydrological inputs for water infrastructure; related records are the CNIG download centre and the FOEN biodiversity geodata.
